title: Improved mechanical and EMI shielding properties of PLA/PCL composites by controlling distribution of PIL-modified CNTs
notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> PLA/PCL/8CNT base + PIL modification + blending-time sweep -> melt blending -> PIL-widened interface -> CNT migration/interfacial localization -> (mechanical branch: phase-size refinement + interface -> elongation/yield) and (electrical branch: interfacial CNT network -> conductivity -> EMI SE, explained by conduction-loss absorption) -> conclusion. Audits o14, o19: at 2 min the PIL composite is worse than the PIL-free one in conductivity and SE, so the paper's blanket 'PIL composites significantly higher' holds for 4-8 min only. Figure-vs-text conflicts in image_note: F6b percolation location (text 4-6 wt%, plot steepest 0-4 wt%) and 0.046 S/m vs ~0.7 S/m; F4 high-frequency G' lower with PIL-2m/4m; F3 Tcc not lower with PIL; F8 legend '4IL'. F9 TEM phase mapping (PLA white, PCL grey) only in text. Lost: Table S1-S3 values, Figs S4-S6, crystallinity. Judge: n10 split into n10 (network present in all blends, G' plateau) and n20 (network most complete with interfacial CNTs, spine, argued, premise k6); n12 split off n21 (yield/ultimate stress); k5 added as premise for n9; o22 audit (PIL-8m coarser) split from o2.
